items.post_title_orig: Said goodbye to our Lukin tonight.
items.post_selftext:
One of the hardest things I've ever had to do... 
 Tonight we said goodbye to our sweet Lou. 
 We named you after a Pearl Jam song that ends too quick.
 Life is like that, blink and it's gone in a flick. 
 Lukin, you were there for me like the band that inspired your name. 
 From bird's feathers to angel's wings, eternal flame. 
 Love you buddy. Rock on. 
    submitted by    /u/hallucinatori
